paragraphs: Mentioned in [Nedarim 38b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.38b.7): “It was taught: Yehoshua of Uza said,” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied heading עיזא, Eiza, differs from body עוזא, Uza, also found in the older machine/catalog heading. No harmonization is made, and neither a genuine printed variant nor a transcription slip is established by this lane.

The linked baraita names Yehoshua of Uza in a discussion about feeding the animals or household servants of someone prohibited by a vow from benefiting from him. The English retains Hyman’s Eiza in the heading and Uza in the quotation.
